Schedule 2 percentages and the Reserve Amount are measured against the Eligible Pool Balance before deducting the Excess Concentration Amount. Limits are applied in the order listed, and an amount excluded under one limit is not counted again under a later limit."},{"name":"Reserve amount","found":true,"value":"1% of Eligible Pool Balance","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 1.1, definition of Reserve Amount","quote":"an amount equal to 1% of the Eligible Pool Balance","note":"Per the Eligible Pool Balance definition, this is measured before deducting the Excess Concentration Amount."},{"name":"Delinquency trigger","found":true,"value":"Three-period average Delinquency Ratio exceeds 6.0%","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 7.1","quote":"the average of the Delinquency Ratio for the three most recently ended Collection Periods exceeds 6.0%","note":"Delinquency Ratio uses Pool Receivables 60 or more days past due, excluding charged-off Defaulted Receivables. While the trigger is continuing, the Revolving Period is suspended. The Subordinated Debt add-back in Section 6.12(c) does not apply to this covenant."},{"name":"Maximum leverage covenant","found":true,"value":"6.00 to 1.00","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 6.12(b)","quote":"does not exceed 6.00 to 1.00","note":"Tested at each fiscal quarter end of the Parent.
